customer_name.description: The customer company named in the case study.

inferred_target_persona.description: The buyer or primary user persona at the customer (e.g. 'Marketing Director', 'VP Engineering', 'IT Operations team'). Inferred from titles, teams, or business functions described.

industry.description: Industry as the page labels it, not normalized.

company_size.description: Any explicit size/scale indicator: headcount, employee range, Fortune ranking, or qualitative ('mid-market', 'enterprise'). Null if not stated.

location.description: Geographic location, headquarters, or primary region of the customer. Null if not stated.

revenue.description: Revenue figure or range if explicitly stated on the page. Null if not stated.

tech_stack.description: Non-vendor technologies, platforms, or tools the customer uses, as mentioned on the page. Exclude the vendor's own products.

other.description: Any other audience-relevant dimension stated on the page (e.g. regulatory environment, growth stage, business model). Null if none.

audience_dimensions.description: Structured audience dimensions extracted from the page.

vendor_products_used.description: Vendor products the customer deployed, as named on the page.

capabilities_cited.description: Specific capabilities the customer used or cited, raw phrasing.

pain_points_cited.description: Challenges/problems the customer faced before deployment. Each entry must be a self-contained sentence understandable without reading the rest of the page.

capability.description: The capability that addressed the pain point.

pain_point.description: The pain point that was addressed.

confidence.description: How clearly the page connects this capability to this pain.

vp_pp_pairs.description: Explicit capability-to-pain-point links found on this page.

quote.description: Supporting quote from the customer, if any.

outcomes.description: Result statements with metrics and optional quotes.
